response.sql: WITH pa AS (SELECT b.player_id, p.bats, AVG(b.double) AS avg_doubles FROM batting_postseason b JOIN player p ON p.player_id = b.player_id GROUP BY b.player_id, p.bats), idx AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, avg_doubles / (SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) FROM pa) AS idx FROM pa), g AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx, idx - AVG(idx) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS gap FROM idx) SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx, gap FROM g ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10
